title: Quiz: Learn With Mentor AI: Getting More Out of Video Courses
description: Check how you use Mentor AI with Real Python video courses, from asking what the instructor said to quizzing yourself after a lesson.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Learn With Mentor AI: Getting More Out of Video Courses . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how to ask Mentor AI about the moment you paused on, point it at a passage in the transcript, and get a different explanation when the first one doesn’t click.
takeaways: You’ll also review what to do when your terminal doesn’t match the recording and how to check what stuck after a lesson.
